name: prefixScores_of_le
doc: 前缀截断保持前缀上的取值：`j ≤ i ⟹ prefixScores s i j = s j`。
stmt:
@[simp] lemma prefixScores_of_le {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (h : j ≤ i) :
    prefixScores s i j = s j
proof:
by
  unfold prefixScores
  rw [if_pos h]

name: prefixScores_of_not_le
doc: 前缀截断丢弃后缀：`¬ j ≤ i ⟹ prefixScores s i j = 0`。
stmt:
@[simp] lemma prefixScores_of_not_le {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (h : ¬ j ≤ i) :
    prefixScores s i j = 0
proof:
by
  unfold prefixScores
  rw [if_neg h]

name: cache_independent_of_future
stmt:
theorem cache_independent_of_future {n : ℕ} (s s' : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n)
    (h : ∀ j, j ≤ i → s j = s' j) :
    causalSoftmax s i = causalSoftmax s' i
proof:
by
  funext j
  unfold causalSoftmax causalDenom
  have hden : (∑ k, (if k ≤ i then Real.exp (s k) else 0))
      = ∑ k, (if k ≤ i then Real.exp (s' k) else 0) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    by_cases hki : k ≤ i
    · rw [if_pos hki, if_pos hki, h k hki]
    · rw [if_neg hki, if_neg hki]
  rw [hden]
  by_cases hji : j ≤ i
  · rw [if_pos hji, if_pos hji, h j hji]
  · rw [if_neg hji, if_neg hji]

name: cache_append_eq_full
stmt:
theorem cache_append_eq_full {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) i = causalSoftmax s i
proof:
by
  symm
  apply cache_independent_of_future
  intro j hj
  rw [prefixScores_of_le s i j hj]

name: cache_row_output_eq_full
stmt:
theorem cache_row_output_eq_full {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (V : Fin n → F) (i : Fin n) :
    cacheRowOutput s V i = causalRowOutput s V i
proof:
by
  unfold cacheRowOutput causalRowOutput
  rw [cache_append_eq_full]

name: cache_output_eq_full
stmt:
theorem cache_output_eq_full {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (V : Fin n → F) :
    causalCacheOutput s V = causalFullOutput s V
proof:
by
  funext i
  exact cache_row_output_eq_full s V i

name: cache_append_preserves_earlier_rows
stmt:
theorem cache_append_preserves_earlier_rows {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (k i : Fin n)
    (hk : k ≤ i) :
    causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) k = causalSoftmax (prefixScores s k) k
proof:
by
  apply cache_independent_of_future
  intro j hj
  rw [prefixScores_of_le s i j (le_trans hj hk), prefixScores_of_le s k j hj]

name: cache_append_preserves_earlier_outputs
doc: 定理五'（输出级）：追加 token 不改变已缓存位置 `k` 的输出行。
stmt:
theorem cache_append_preserves_earlier_outputs {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (V : Fin n → F)
    (k i : Fin n) (hk : k ≤ i) :
    convComb (causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) k) V
      = convComb (causalSoftmax (prefixScores s k) k) V
proof:
by
  rw [cache_append_preserves_earlier_rows s k i hk]

name: cache_weights_supported_on_prefix
stmt:
theorem cache_weights_supported_on_prefix {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n)
    (h : ¬ j ≤ i) : causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) i j = 0
proof: causalSoftmax_eq_zero_of_gt (prefixScores s i) i j h

name: cache_row_output_supported_on_prefix
doc:
定理六'：缓存行输出只需前缀 `j ≤ i` 上的 value
（`Σ_{j ∈ univ} = Σ_{j ∈ Iic i}`，因后缀权重为 0）。
stmt:
theorem cache_row_output_supported_on_prefix {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (V : Fin n → F)
    (i : Fin n) :
    cacheRowOutput s V i
      = ∑ j in Finset.Iic i, causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) i j • V j
proof:
by
  unfold cacheRowOutput convComb
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)
  intro x _ hxnot
  have hxi : ¬ x ≤ i := fun h => hxnot (Finset.mem_Iic.mpr h)
  rw [cache_weights_supported_on_prefix s i x hxi, zero_smul]

name: cache_memory_bound
stmt:
theorem cache_memory_bound {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin n => causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) i j ≠ 0)).card
      ≤ cacheLength i
proof:
by
  have hsub : Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin n => causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) i j ≠ 0)
      ⊆ Finset.Iic i := by
    intro j hj
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hj
    rw [Finset.mem_Iic]
    by_contra hji
    exact hj.2 (cache_weights_supported_on_prefix s i j hji)
  calc
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin n => causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) i j ≠ 0)).card
        ≤ (Finset.Iic i).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ = i.val + 1 := Fin.card_Iic i
    _ = cacheLength i := rfl

name: cache_output_bound
stmt:
theorem cache_output_bound {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (V : Fin n → F) (i : Fin n) (M : ℝ)
    (hV : ∀ j, ‖V j‖ ≤ M) : ‖cacheRowOutput s V i‖ ≤ M
proof:
by
  unfold cacheRowOutput
  exact causal_attention_output_bound (prefixScores s i) i V M hV

end Lattice

name: featScore_nonneg
doc: `featScore` 非负（`φ ≥ 0`）。
stmt:
lemma featScore_nonneg {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) (q k : Fin d → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ featScore φ q k
proof:
by
  unfold featScore
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hφ _) (hφ _)

name: linAttnDenom_nonneg
doc: 分母非负（`φ ≥ 0`）。
stmt:
lemma linAttnDenom_nonneg {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) : 0 ≤ linAttnDenom φ q K
proof:
by
  unfold linAttnDenom
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => featScore_nonneg φ hφ q (K j)

name: linAttnDenom_pos
doc: 分母为正：只要存在某个位置核分数为正（`φ ≥ 0` 下即该位置有非零特征）。
stmt:
lemma linAttnDenom_pos {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (hne : ∃ j, 0 < featScore φ q (K j)) :
    0 < linAttnDenom φ q K
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hne
  unfold linAttnDenom
  exact Finset.sum_pos'
    (fun l _ => featScore_nonneg φ hφ q (K l))
    ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, hj⟩

name: linear_attn_weights_nonneg
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_weights_nonneg {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (j : ι) : 0 ≤ linAttnWeights φ q K j
proof:
by
  unfold linAttnWeights
  exact div_nonneg (featScore_nonneg φ hφ q (K j)) (linAttnDenom_nonneg φ hφ q K)

name: linear_attn_weights_sum_one
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_weights_sum_one {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (hne : ∃ j, 0 < featScore φ q (K j)) :
    ∑ j, linAttnWeights φ q K j = 1
proof:
by
  have hD : linAttnDenom φ q K ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (linAttnDenom_pos φ hφ q K hne)
  unfold linAttnWeights
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  exact div_self hD

name: linear_attn_weights_pmf
doc: 归一化后线性注意力权重构成概率分布（非负 + 和为 1）。
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_weights_pmf {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (hne : ∃ j, 0 < featScore φ q (K j)) :
    (∀ j, 0 ≤ linAttnWeights φ q K j) ∧ (∑ j, linAttnWeights φ q K j = 1)
proof:
⟨fun j => linear_attn_weights_nonneg φ hφ q K j,
   linear_attn_weights_sum_one φ hφ q K hne⟩

name: linear_attn_output_bound
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_output_bound {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (hne : ∃ j, 0 < featScore φ q (K j))
    (V : ι → F) (M : ℝ) (hV : ∀ j, ‖V j‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖linearAttentionOutput φ q K V‖ ≤ M
proof:
convComb_norm_bound (linAttnWeights φ q K) V M
    (linear_attn_weights_nonneg φ hφ q K)
    (linear_attn_weights_sum_one φ hφ q K hne) hV

name: linear_attn_is_softmax
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_is_softmax {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ j, 0 < featScore φ q (K j)) :
    linAttnWeights φ q K = softmax (fun j => Real.log (featScore φ q (K j)))
proof:
by
  funext j
  unfold linAttnWeights linAttnDenom softmax
  rw [Real.exp_log (hpos j)]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => (Real.exp_log (hpos l)).symm

name: softmax_vs_linear
stmt:
theorem softmax_vs_linear (q : Fin 1 → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin 1 → ℝ) :
    linAttnWeights Real.exp q K = softmax (fun j => q 0 + K j 0)
proof:
by
  have hterm : ∀ (k : Fin 1 → ℝ),
      (∑ i : Fin 1, Real.exp (q i) * Real.exp (k i)) = Real.exp (q 0 + k 0) := by
    intro k
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, ← Real.exp_add]
  funext j
  unfold linAttnWeights linAttnDenom featScore softmax
  rw [hterm (K j)]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => hterm (K l)

name: linear_attn_associativity
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_associativity {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q : Fin d → ℝ)
    (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (V : ι → F) :
    linearAttentionNum φ q K V = ∑ i : Fin d, φ (q i) • linAttnState φ K V i
proof:
by
  unfold linearAttentionNum linAttnState featScore
  simp only [Finset.sum_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => mul_smul _ _ _

name: linear_attn_state_form
doc: 状态复用形式（定理六的改写）：输出分子 = `Σ_i φ(q_i) • state_i`。
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_state_form {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q : Fin d → ℝ)
    (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (V : ι → F) :
    linearAttentionNum φ q K V = ∑ i : Fin d, φ (q i) • linAttnState φ K V i
proof:
linear_attn_associativity φ q K V

name: linearAttentionOutput_eq_inv_smul_num
stmt:
theorem linearAttentionOutput_eq_inv_smul_num {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q : Fin d → ℝ)
    (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (V : ι → F) :
    linearAttentionOutput φ q K V = (linAttnDenom φ q K)⁻¹ • linearAttentionNum φ q K V
proof:
by
  unfold linearAttentionOutput linearAttentionNum linAttnWeights
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_

name: linear_attn_complexity
doc: `d ≤ n` 时核化形式的计数量不超过显式形式。
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_complexity {n d : ℕ} (h : d ≤ n) :
    linearAttentionOps n d ≤ denseAttentionOps n
proof:
by
  unfold linearAttentionOps denseAttentionOps
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left n h

name: linear_attn_complexity_strict
doc: 严格版本：`d < n` 且 `n > 0` 时严格更少（真正的 `O(n)` vs `O(n²)` 节省）。
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_complexity_strict {n d : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (h : d < n) :
    linearAttentionOps n d < denseAttentionOps n
proof:
by
  unfold linearAttentionOps denseAttentionOps
  exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h hn

name: mla_absorb_key
doc:
**吸收律**：naive 分数 = 吸收分数。
`⟨q, W_UK c⟩ = ⟨W_UK† q, c⟩`——伴随的内积刻画（`adjoint_inner_left`）。
这是 MLA 推理优化的**全部代数内容**：不必物化 `k = W_UK c`。
stmt:
theorem mla_absorb_key (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) (q : E) (c : L) :
    mlaScoreNaive WUK q c = mlaScoreAbsorbed WUK q c
proof:
by
  unfold mlaScoreNaive mlaScoreAbsorbed
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left WUK c q).symm

name: mla_absorb_all_tokens
doc:
**全 token 吸收律**：对 token 集 `ι` 上逐点成立的吸收，整体成立。
说明吸收是**逐 token 可交换**的，与序列长度无关——这正是推理时能全程不物化 `k` 的理由。
stmt:
theorem mla_absorb_all_tokens {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) (q : E) (c : ι → L) :
    (∑ t, mlaScoreNaive WUK q (c t)) = ∑ t, mlaScoreAbsorbed WUK q (c t)
proof:
by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  exact mla_absorb_key WUK q (c t)

name: mla_cache_le_full_cache
doc: **缓存不增**：`d_c ≤ 2 * H * d_h` 时 MLA 的每 token 缓存不超过全秩 MHA。
stmt:
theorem mla_cache_le_full_cache (d_c H d_h : ℕ)
    (h : d_c ≤ 2 * H * d_h) :
    mlaCachePerToken d_c ≤ fullCachePerToken H d_h
proof:
by
  unfold mlaCachePerToken fullCachePerToken
  exact h

name: mla_cache_strict
doc: **严格压缩**：`d_c < 2 * H * d_h` 时 MLA 缓存**严格更小**（真压缩，非等于）。
stmt:
theorem mla_cache_strict (d_c H d_h : ℕ)
    (h : d_c < 2 * H * d_h) :
    mlaCachePerToken d_c < fullCachePerToken H d_h
proof:
by
  unfold mlaCachePerToken fullCachePerToken
  exact h

name: mla_cache_le_full_cache_seq
doc:
**序列级缓存界**：长度 `n` 的序列上，MLA 缓存总量 `n * d_c` 不超过全秩总量
`n * (2 * H * d_h)`（`d_c ≤ 2 * H * d_h`）。
stmt:
theorem mla_cache_le_full_cache_seq (n d_c H d_h : ℕ)
    (h : d_c ≤ 2 * H * d_h) :
    n * mlaCachePerToken d_c ≤ n * fullCachePerToken H d_h
proof:
by
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left n (mla_cache_le_full_cache d_c H d_h h)

name: mla_compression_ratio_ge_one
doc:
**压缩率下界**：若全秩缓存 `≥ 1` 且 MLA 缓存 `≤ d_c`，则
压缩比 `(2*H*d_h) / d_c ≥ 1`。这条把「省内存」变成一个可计算的比较。
stmt:
theorem mla_compression_ratio_ge_one (d_c H d_h : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d_c)
    (h : d_c ≤ 2 * H * d_h) :
    1 ≤ fullCachePerToken H d_h / d_c
proof:
by
  unfold fullCachePerToken
  exact Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hd |>.mpr (by rw [one_mul]; exact h)

name: absorb_requires_image
doc:
**吸收可实施性**：若键确实由 latent 上投影得到（`k = W_UK c`），
则 `⟨q, k⟩ = ⟨W_UK† q, c⟩`。这是吸收律在「键有来源」前提下的重述。
stmt:
theorem absorb_requires_image (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) (q : E) (c : L) :
    inner (𝕜 := ℝ) q (WUK c) =
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint WUK q) c
proof: mla_absorb_key WUK q c

name: mla_absorb_exists_operator
doc:
**吸收律的 operator 形式**：存在算子 `A : E →L[ℝ] L`（显式 `W_UK†`）使
`∀ q c, ⟨q, W_UK c⟩ = ⟨A q, c⟩`。把「重结合」陈述为**存在性**，
从而与负对照（不存在这样的 `A`）形成同一命题的正反两面。
stmt:
theorem mla_absorb_exists_operator (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) :
    ∃ A : E →L[ℝ] L, ∀ (q : E) (c : L),
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ) q (WUK c) = inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (A q) c
proof: ⟨ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint WUK, fun q c => mla_absorb_key WUK q c⟩

name: nc_absorbed_not_identically_zero
doc:
NC-1（**吸收分数依赖上投影，非恒零**）：取 `W_UK = id`、`q = c = 1`，
吸收分数为 `1 ≠ 0`。若 `mlaScoreAbsorbed` 恒为 0，本定理不可证，
则 `mla_absorb_key` 退化为 `0 = 0` 的空话。
stmt:
theorem nc_absorbed_not_identically_zero :
    mlaScoreAbsorbed (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) (1 : ℝ) (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0
proof:
by
  unfold mlaScoreAbsorbed
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_id]
  simp [ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]

name: nc_absorption_impossible_for_free_key
doc:
NC-2（**吸收不是对任意键成立**）：在 ℝ 上，不存在算子 `A` 能把
**独立于 `c`** 的键写成 `⟨A q, c⟩`（对一切 `c` 成立）。
取 `q = 1`、键 `k = 1`：`c = 0` 迫使 `1 = 0`，矛盾。
这是「键必须落在上投影的像里」的具体见证。
stmt:
theorem nc_absorption_impossible_for_free_key :
    ¬ ∃ A : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ c : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) = inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (A (1 : ℝ)) c
proof:
by
  rintro ⟨A, hA⟩
  have h0 : (1 : ℝ) = inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (A (1 : ℝ)) 0 := hA 0
  simp only [inner_zero_right] at h0
  norm_num at h0

name: nc_cache_strict_needs_hypothesis
doc:
NC-3（**严格压缩的前提可失败**）：不带维度假设时，严格不等式**不成立**。
取 `d_c = 4, H = 1, d_h = 1`：`4 < 2` 为假。这把 `mla_cache_strict` 的
假设从「装饰」降为**真实前提**（若删去假设仍可证，该定理是空的）。
stmt:
theorem nc_cache_strict_needs_hypothesis :
    ¬ (mlaCachePerToken 4 < fullCachePerToken 1 1)
proof:
by
  unfold mlaCachePerToken fullCachePerToken
  norm_num

end Lattice

name: mla_absorbed_opNorm_le
doc:
**吸收的算子范数代价**：`‖W_UK† ∘ W_Q‖ ≤ ‖W_UK‖ * ‖W_Q‖`。
（伴随等距 `‖W_UK†‖ = ‖W_UK‖` 与复合的次乘性。）
这是 MLA 特有的定量界：吸收不是免费的，其代价由两个投影的范数之积控制。
stmt:
theorem mla_absorbed_opNorm_le (WQ : E →L[ℝ] E) (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) :
    ‖mlaAbsorbedMap WQ WUK‖ ≤ ‖WUK‖ * ‖WQ‖
proof:
by
  unfold mlaAbsorbedMap
  calc ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint WUK).comp WQ‖
      ≤ ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint WUK‖ * ‖WQ‖ :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _
    _ = ‖WUK‖ * ‖WQ‖ := by rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint.norm_map]

name: mla_score_eq_absorbedMap
doc:
**吸收打分 = 预合成算子打分**：把 `mla_absorb_query` 重述为算子形式，
说明「吸收」在陈述层面就是一次算子应用。
stmt:
theorem mla_score_eq_absorbedMap (WQ : E →L[ℝ] E) (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) (x : E) (c : L) :
    inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (WQ x) (WUK c) = inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (mlaAbsorbedMap WQ WUK x) c
proof:
by
  unfold mlaAbsorbedMap
  exact mla_absorb_query WQ WUK x c

name: mla_score_eq_plain_inner
doc:
**恒等退化 ⟹ 普通内积打分**：`W_UK = id`（不压缩）时，
MLA 的吸收打分退化为普通内积打分 `⟨q, c⟩`——

    (W : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (p : ℕ) (q : Fin k) (M B c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hM : ∀ i : Fin k, ‖V i‖ ≤ M)
    (i : ℕ) (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hBx : ‖x‖ ≤ B) (hBy : ‖y‖ ≤ B)
    (hx : c ≤ ‖x + SoftmaxAttnOp S V x + W i x‖)
    (hy : c ≤ ‖y + SoftmaxAttnOp S V y + W i y‖)
    (hx' : c ≤ ‖x + CausalSoftmaxAttnOp S V q x + W i x‖)

  · have hb := hetero_block_lipschitz_numeric S V W M B c hc hM i x y hBx hBy hx hy

    (hM : ∀ i : Fin k, ‖V i‖ ≤ M)

    (hBc : ∀ j ≤ m,
      ‖ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j (x)‖ ≤ B
      ∧ ‖ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j (y)‖ ≤ B)
    (hreach : ∀ j ≤ m,
        c ≤ ‖ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j x
              + SoftmaxAttnOp S V (ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j x)
              + W j (ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j x)‖
      ∧ c ≤ ‖ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j y
              + SoftmaxAttnOp S V (ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j y)
              + W j (ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j y)‖)
    (hreach' : ∀ j ≤ m,

      ∧ c ≤ ‖ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j y
              + CausalSoft

by
  exact chainN_dom_bound (MixedBlock S V W p q)
    (fun i : ℕ => heteroBlockLb S W M B c i) m x y
    (fun i hi =>
      mixed_block_lipschitz_numeric S V W p q M B c hc hM i
        (ChainFwd (MixedBlock S V W p q) i x) (ChainFwd (MixedBlock S V W p q) i y)
        (hBc i (Nat.le_of_lt hi)).1 (hBc i (Nat.le_of_lt hi)).2
        (hreach i (Nat.le_of_lt hi)).1 (hreach i (Nat.le_of_lt hi)).2
        (hreach' i (Nat.le_of_lt hi)).1 (hreach' i (Nat.le_of_lt hi)).2)

theorem mixed_chain_numeric_bound_split {n k : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero k]

    (V : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (W : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (p : ℕ) (q : Fin k) (M B c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hM : ∀ i : Fin k, ‖V i‖ ≤ M)
    (m : ℕ) (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
                                                                    
                                                                 
    (hBc : ∀ j ≤ m,
      ‖ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j (x)‖ ≤ B
      ∧ ‖ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j (y)‖ ≤ B)
    (hreach : ∀ j ≤ m,
        c ≤ ‖ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j x
              + SoftmaxAttnOp S V (ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j x)
              + W j (ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j x)‖
      ∧ c ≤ ‖ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j y
              + SoftmaxAttnOp S V (ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j y)
              + W j (ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j y)‖)
    (hreach' : ∀ j ≤ m,
        c ≤ ‖ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j x
              + CausalSoftmaxAttnOp S V q (ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j x)
              + W j (ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j x)‖
      ∧ c ≤ ‖ChainFwd (fun i : ℕ => MixedBlock S V W p q i) j y
              + Caus
proof:
by
  have hb := mixed_chain_numeric_bound S V W p q M B c hc hM m x y hBc hreach hreach'
  have hsplit : (∏ i in Finset.range m, heteroBlockLb S W M B c i)
      = (∏ i in Finset.range p, heteroBlockLb S W M B c i) *
        (∏ i in Finset.range (m - p), heteroBlockLb S W M B c (p + i)) := by
    calc
      (∏ i in Finset.range m, heteroBlockLb S W M B c i)
          = ∏ i in Finset.range (p + (m - p)), heteroBlockLb S W M B c i := by
            rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hpm]
      _ = (∏ i in Finset.range p, heteroBlockLb S W M B c i) *
          (∏ i in Finset.range (m - p), heteroBlockLb S W M B c (p + i)) := by
            exact Finset.prod_range_add (heteroBlockLb S W M B c) p (m - p)
  rw [hsplit] at hb
  exact hb

name: PositionEncoding.error_bound
doc: **接口蕴含（单步）**：`|(u+φx) − (v+φy)| ≤ |u−v| + L·distF x y`。
stmt:
theorem PositionEncoding.error_bound (E : PositionEncoding ι) (u v : ℝ) (x y : ι) :
    |(u + E.phi x) - (v + E.phi y)| ≤ |u - v| + E.L * E.distF x y
proof:
by
  have h : (u + E.phi x) - (v + E.phi y) = (u - v) + (E.phi x - E.phi y) := by ring
  rw [h]
  calc |(u - v) + (E.phi x - E.phi y)| ≤ |u - v| + |E.phi x - E.phi y| := abs_add _ _
    _ ≤ |u - v| + E.L * E.distF x y := by linarith [E.lipschitz x y]

name: PositionEncoding.error_bound_of_close
doc:
**接口蕴含（近似形式）**：`|u−v| ≤ ε`、`distF x y ≤ δ`（`δ ≥ 0`）⟹
`|(u+φx) − (v+φy)| ≤ ε + L·δ`。
stmt:
theorem PositionEncoding.error_bound_of_close (E : PositionEncoding ι) (u v : ℝ) (x y : ι)
    {eps delta : ℝ} (huv : |u - v| ≤ eps) (hxy : E.distF x y ≤ delta) (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) :
    |(u + E.phi x) - (v + E.phi y)| ≤ eps + E.L * delta
proof:
by
  have hLd : E.L * E.distF x y ≤ E.L * delta := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxy E.hL
  calc |(u + E.phi x) - (v + E.phi y)| ≤ |u - v| + E.L * E.distF x y :=
        E.error_bound u v x y
    _ ≤ eps + E.L * delta := by linarith

name: PositionEncoding.output_bound
doc: **接口蕴含（输出界）**：`|u + φx| ≤ |u| + B`。
stmt:
theorem PositionEncoding.output_bound (E : PositionEncoding ι) (u : ℝ) (x : ι) :
    |u + E.phi x| ≤ |u| + E.B
proof:
by
  calc |u + E.phi x| ≤ |u| + |E.phi x| := abs_add _ _
    _ ≤ |u| + E.B := by linarith [E.bounded x]

name: PositionEncoding.stack_error_bound
doc:
**接口蕴含（端到端 / n 项求和）**：逐项误差 `≤ ε`、位置距离 `≤ δ` ⟹
`|Σ_k (u_k + φ x_k) − Σ_k (v_k + φ y_k)| ≤ n·(ε + L·δ)`。
proof:
by
  have h1 : ∑ k, (u k + E.phi (x k)) - ∑ k, (v k + E.phi (y k))
      = ∑ k, ((u k + E.phi (x k)) - (v k + E.phi (y k))) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [h1]
  calc |∑ k, ((u k + E.phi (x k)) - (v k + E.phi (y k)))|
      ≤ ∑ k, |(u k + E.phi (x k)) - (v k + E.phi (y k))| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _k : Fin n, (eps + E.L * delta) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro k _
        exact E.error_bound_of_close (u k) (v k) (x k) (y k) (huv k) (hxy k) hdelta
    _ = n * (eps + E.L * delta) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: div_abs_self_eq_pm_one
doc: **`θ/|θ| = ±1`**（`θ ≠ 0`）：分离辅助引理，避免在主证明里纠缠 `abs`/`div` 的重写。
stmt: theorem div_abs_self_eq_pm_one (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ ≠ 0) : θ / |θ| = 1 ∨ θ / |θ| = -1
proof:
by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hθ.symm with h | h

    left
    rw [abs_of_pos h]
    exact div_self (ne_of_gt h)
  ·

name: rope_L_sharp
doc:
**RoPE：`θ ≠ 0` 时 `|cos 0 − cos (θ s)| = 1`（`s = π/(2|θ|)`）**。

⚠ **定理名 `rope_L_sharp` 是历史名称，名不副实（保留不改以兼容既有引用）**：
本定理**不**声称 `L = |θ|` 被取等。它只证明：取 `s = π/(2|θ|)` 时
`|cos 0 − cos (θ s)| = 1`（用 `θ·s = ±π/2`，故 `cos (θ s) = 0`）。

**为什么不能声称 `L = |θ|` 取等**（**退回推理，保留自本文件早期版本**）：
`cos` 是 `1`-Lipschitz（`abs_cos_sub_cos_le`），而 `L = |θ|` 的界来自
「`cos(θ·)` 的 Lipschitz 常数 `= |θ|`」。**取等需要 `|θ|·|s| = 1` 且
`cos(θs) = 0` 同时成立**，即 `|θ|·|s| = 1` 与 `|θ s| = π/2` 同时成立
⟹ `π/2 = 1`，**不可能**。
（曾试两条路径并均被否：① `s = π/(2|θ|)` ⟹ 左端 `= |1 − 0| = 1`、
右端 `= |θ|·|s| = π/2`，**`1 ≠ π/2`**；② 取 `θs = ±π` 使 `cos(θs) = −1`
⟹ 左端 `|1 − (−1)| = 2`、右端 `|θ|·(π/|θ|) = π`，**仍不等**。）

因此本节**不**声称 `L = |θ|` 取等；真正成立的是 **`sup` 意义下的最优常数**
`= |θ|`（由「对任意 `c < |θ|`，存在 `s` 使 `|cos 0 − cos(θs)| > c·|s|`」刻画）。
⚠ **该 `sup` 版最优性本文件未做**：与之对应的计划名 `rope_L_sharp_sup`
（用 `s → 0⁺` 的差商极限）**在全库不存在**，故该路径**零形式化内容**。
stmt:
theorem rope_L_sharp (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ ≠ 0) :
    |Real.cos (θ * 0) - Real.cos (θ * (Real.pi / (2 * |θ|)))| = 1
proof:
by
  have harg : θ * (Real.pi / (2 * |θ|)) = (θ / |θ|) * (Real.pi / 2) := by ring
  have hpm := div_abs_self_eq_pm_one θ hθ
  have hzero : θ * 0 = 0 := mul_zero θ
  rw [hzero, harg, Real.cos_zero]
  rcases hpm with h | h
  · rw [h, one_mul, Real.cos_pi_div_two, sub_zero, abs_one]
  · rw [h, neg_one_mul, Real.cos_neg, Real.cos_pi_div_two, sub_zero, abs_one]

name: abs_le_one_of_sq_add_sq
doc:
**`a² + b² = 1` ⟹ `|a| ≤ 1 ∧ |b| ≤ 1`**（由 `sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one`）。

⚠ **改名说明（v14）**：本定理原名 `exists_abs_eq_one_of_sq_add_sq`，
**名字暗示 `∃ …, |·| = 1`，与实际内容（`≤ 1`）不符**，已按内容改名。
**原"取等"命题为假**：`a² + b² = 1` **不**蕴含 `|a| = 1 ∨ |b| = 1`
（反例 `a = b = √2/2`，二者都 ≈ 0.707）。本文件对 `B = 1` 的**可达性**
改由显式取等点证明（见 `absPos_B_sharp`）。
stmt:
theorem abs_le_one_of_sq_add_sq {a b : ℝ} (h : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 1) :
    |a| ≤ 1 ∧ |b| ≤ 1
proof:
by
  have ha : a ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg b]
  have hb : b ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg a]
  exact ⟨(sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one a).mp ha, (sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one b).mp hb⟩

name: absPos_B_sharp
doc:
**绝对编码的 `B = 1` sharp（显式取等点，奇分量）**：对满足 `2m+1 < d` 的频率，
**取 `pos` 使 `pos/D = π`**（`D = absPosDenom d ⟨2m+1,…⟩`），
则**奇分量**（`cos`）取 `|PE| = 1`（因 `cos π = −1`）。

即 `B = 1` 对绝对编码是**可达**的（不是仅由 `|cos| ≤ 1` 得到的开界）。

⚠ **v14 修正（原陈述为假）**：本定理原取**偶**分量（`2m`，即 `sin`）并声称
`|PE| = 1`，但 `sin π = 0` ⟹ `|PE| = 0 ≠ 1`——**该陈述不可证**（构建报
`unsolved goals ⊢ False`）。已改为**奇**分量（`cos`）：`cos π = −1` ⟹ `|−1| = 1` 成立。
stmt:
theorem absPos_B_sharp (d : ℕ) (m : ℕ) (h1 : 2 * m + 1 < d) :
    |absPosEnc d (Real.pi * absPosDenom d ⟨2 * m + 1, h1⟩) ⟨2 * m + 1, h1⟩| = 1
proof:
by
  have hD : 0 < absPosDenom d ⟨2 * m + 1, h1⟩ := absPosDenom_pos d _
  have hmod : ¬ ((⟨2 * m + 1, h1⟩ : Fin d).val % 2 = 0) := fin_two_mul_add_one_not_mod d m h1
  have hval : Real.pi * absPosDenom d ⟨2 * m + 1, h1⟩ / absPosDenom d ⟨2 * m + 1, h1⟩
      = Real.pi :=
    mul_div_cancel_right₀ Real.pi (ne_of_gt hD)
  have hcos : Real.cos (Real.pi * absPosDenom d ⟨2 * m + 1, h1⟩ / absPosDenom d ⟨2 * m + 1, h1⟩)
      = -1 := by
    rw [hval, Real.cos_pi]
  have henc : absPosEnc d (Real.pi * absPosDenom d ⟨2 * m + 1, h1⟩) ⟨2 * m + 1, h1⟩ = -1 := by
    show (if (⟨2 * m + 1, h1⟩ : Fin d).val % 2 = 0
        then Real.sin (Real.pi * absPosDenom d ⟨2 * m + 1, h1⟩
              / absPosDenom d ⟨2 * m + 1, h1⟩)
        else Real.cos (Real.pi * absPosDenom d ⟨2 * m + 1, h1⟩
              / absPosDenom d ⟨2 * m + 1, h1⟩)) = -1
    rw [if_neg hmod, hcos]
  rw [henc, abs_neg, abs_one]

name: absPos_smooth_sharp
doc:
**绝对编码的 `L`：`1/D` 是一个更紧的可行上界**：
`|PE p i − PE q i| ≤ (1/D)·|p − q|`，其中 `D = absPosDenom d i ≥ 1`。

**意义**：`RealAbsPosEncoding.abs_pos_smooth` 与接口字段用的 `L = 1` 是**偏松的**；
`1/D ≤ 1`，且 `D > 1` 时严格更小。

⚠ **诚实标注（v14 修正）**：本定理**只证明 `1/D` 是可行（admissible）常数**，
**未证明它是"紧"（最优）常数**。原 docstring 称"紧常数是 `1/D`"属**过度声称**。
数学上 `1/D` 确是最优 Lipschitz 常数（`sup|f′| = 1/D`），但**其最优性未形式化**
（需差商上确界论证，**未做**）；且该常数在任何 `D` 上**都不被取等**
（`sin`/`cos` 在非退化区间上 `|f′|` 不恒为 `1/D`），故不存在"取等见证"。
stmt:
theorem absPos_smooth_sharp (d : ℕ) (p q : ℝ) (i : Fin d) :
    |absPosEnc d p i - absPosEnc d q i| ≤ (absPosDenom d i)⁻¹ * |p - q|
proof:
by
  have hD : 0 < absPosDenom d i := absPosDenom_pos d i
  have hdiv : |p / absPosDenom d i - q / absPosDenom d i| ≤ (absPosDenom d i)⁻¹ * |p - q| := by
    have heq : p / absPosDenom d i - q / absPosDenom d i = (p - q) / absPosDenom d i := by ring
    rw [heq, abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hD), div_eq_inv_mul, mul_comm]
  unfold absPosEnc
  by_cases h : i.val % 2 = 0
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
    exact le_trans (abs_sin_sub_sin_le _ _) hdiv
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h]
    exact le_trans (abs_cos_sub_cos_le _ _) hdiv

name: absPos_L_improved
doc:
**`1/D < 1`（`D > 1`）—— 一条关于倒数的纯算术事实**。

⚠ **诚实标注（v14 修正）**：本定理的陈述**只涉及数值 `1/D` 与 `1` 的大小关系**，
**不是**"`absPosEnc` 的 Lipschitz 常数被严格改进"的陈述（那需要先证 `1/D` 最优，
**未做**）。原 docstring 称"常数的 `1/1` 都被严格改进"易被误读为后者，已修正措辞。
它确实**支持**"`L = 1` 偏松"这一定性结论（配合 `absPos_smooth_sharp` 的上界）。
stmt:
theorem absPos_L_improved (d : ℕ) (i : Fin d) (hD : 1 < absPosDenom d i) :
    (absPosDenom d i)⁻¹ < 1
proof:
by
  rw [inv_lt_one_iff₀]
  right
  exact hD
